Elaine: Quick sync — final checklist for webinar launch content + post. Need redirects, schema, internal linking, and benchmark narrative alignment. Launch Thu.
Priya: I'll run a focused crawl on /resources and /demos, export CSV of redirect targets. ETA Tue am.
Sam: On-page owners: I'll adjust H1/H2 and update meta descriptions to include primary keywords: 'LLM inference latency' and 'reduce inference cost'.
Jackson: I'll author JSON-LD for Event + FAQ. Need final startDate and recording URL to finish VideoObject.
Priya: Found 6 legacy redirects from /old-guides -> /resources -> /benchmarks (2-hop). Recommend flatten to single 301 to /benchmarks/llm-latency.
Sam: Agreed. Keep UTM params preserved. For nginx use:
```
rewrite ^/old-guides/(.*)$ /benchmarks/llm-latency/$1?utm_source=$arg_utm_source permanent;
```
Jackson: JSON-LD snippet I'll add to head once PR branch created. Will include schema.org/Event and VideoObject for the recording.
SEO_Bot: Crawl summary: 43 pages missing canonical, 9 redirect chains, 1 blocked by robots. Report cr-2026-05-02-llm.
Elaine: Priya, highlight any duplicate-content candidates; we'll set canonicals if we can't resolve before launch. Sam, make sure internal links from resources hub point to the webinar and benchmark post.
Priya: Will do. Also flag high-risk slugs: /demos/latency-demo and /beta/latency-demo. Those need consolidation.
Sam: I'll add two contextual links from the resources hub to the webinar landing and the benchmarks post. Also adding long-tail H2s: 'how to cut inference cost per token' etc.
Jackson: Draft JSON-LD (placeholder dates/URLs):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Scaling LLM Inference","startDate":"2026-05-06T18:00:00Z","location":"Online","description":"Webinar on latency, cost, and production serving."}
```
Elaine: Owners and deliverables: Priya = redirect map + canonical audit CSV, Sam = H1/H2/meta + internal link plan, Jackson = JSON-LD + FAQ snippets, Elaine = benchmark narrative + post-launch recording placement. Target: all PRs in by Tue EOD.
Sam: I'll drop the content PR link here when ready.
Priya: If any legacy demo pages appear in the crawl, ping me immediate. I'll prioritize consolidations.
Elaine: Thanks team — let's keep this thread as the source of truth for SEO fixes. :rocket:
